class WangBrush:
    """Dynamic virtual brush of Wang, Chen, Deng, Hutchinson, Dellaert (IROS 2020, arXiv 1911.08002, Sec. IV-B), re-implemented from

    the brush is held vertically, so π(X) is the tip's xy) and the press depth z (m, > 0 below the paper):
        w <- K_w w + (1 - K_w) Width(z)          d <- K_d d + (1 - K_d) Drag(z)                           (eqs. 6, 7)
        o <- min(Offset(z), |π(X) - root|)        the hairs stay put on the paper until the handle is Offset(z) away   (eq. 8)
        θ <- direction from the root to π(X)      root <- π(X) - o V(θ)                                     (eqs. 1, 9)
    Width/Drag/Offset(z) = the Fig. 4 fits (BRUSH_WANG), 0 when the tip is not below the paper (the hairs straighten: o = 0, the
    root snaps to the handle). Gaps filled here (documented in DESIGN): eq. 9 as printed (V^-1(root - π(X))) has the opposite sign of
    eq. 1; we follow eq. 1 and Fig. 3 (the flat end faces the handle, the drag tail points away from it). θ keeps its value while

*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a replayable 16-stroke copy of the frozen 靜 exemplar."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt, map_coordinates
+
+from rcb_brush import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+PX = 0.22718 / 1024.0
+
+# Hand traced from the target's medial lines, in target image pixels (u, v).
+# Each is an exemplar brush gesture; the lower-right enclosure is the long
+# turning stroke in 靜, and joins are intentionally supplied by the crossings.
+STROKES = [
+    [(393, 220), (397, 242), (395, 275), (394, 330), (394, 385), (394, 444)],
+    [(303, 329), (345, 321), (389, 313), (431, 301), (466, 296)],
+    [(318, 392), (354, 385), (394, 376), (442, 366)],
+    [(220, 477), (278, 465), (336, 455), (397, 444), (470, 432)],
+    [(318, 509), (328, 535), (325, 576), (322, 622), (319, 665), (311, 699), (309, 727)],
+    [(330, 525), (365, 515), (400, 504), (430, 498), (444, 509), (448, 548), (447, 602), (446, 651), (443, 676), (429, 708)],
+    [(340, 578), (360, 573), (382, 568), (402, 565)],
+    [(336, 629), (359, 624), (380, 619), (400, 616)],
+    [(693, 236), (665, 241), (632, 250), (596, 260), (555, 272), (515, 280)],
+    [(512, 328), (522, 341), (533, 354), (544, 367)],
+    [(579, 304), (590, 317), (600, 332), (608, 345)],
+    [(720, 298), (696, 321), (674, 346), (654, 369), (636, 386)],
+    [(506, 438), (551, 429), (600, 419), (650, 407), (679, 401), (698, 407), (712, 421), (710, 441), (701, 467), (693, 500), (686, 556)],
+    [(482, 516), (535, 506), (591, 496), (648, 488), (705, 481), (755, 481), (810, 483)],
+    [(500, 586), (550, 577), (602, 569), (652, 562), (687, 556), (703, 565)],
+    [(604, 438), (608, 476), (612, 515), (616, 558), (620, 600), (623, 642), (619, 678), (609, 711), (592, 739), (578, 758), (555, 750), (516, 737)],
+]
+
+
+def resample(poly: np.ndarray, spacing_px: float = 4.0) -> np.ndarray:
+    points = []
+    for a, b in zip(poly[:-1], poly[1:]):
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) / spacing_px)))
+        for k in range(n):
+            points.append(a + (b - a) * (k / n))
+    points.append(poly[-1])
+    return np.asarray(points, np.float64)
+
+
+def main():
+    target = cv2.imread("/app/target.png", cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
+    mask = target < 120
+    dist = distance_transform_edt(mask).astype(np.float64)
+
+    s = Session(instance=INSTANCE, render=False)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    bad_ik = 0
+
+    def go(pos, speed=0.06, settle=0):
+        nonlocal bad_ik
+        r = p["move_tip"](np.asarray(pos, np.float64), speed=speed, settle=settle)
+        bad_ik += r["ik_failures"]
+
+    def cmd(pos):
+        nonlocal bad_ik
+        q, ok, _ = s.ik(pos, q_init=s.hold_action())
+        if ok:
+            s.step(q)
+        else:
+            bad_ik += 1
+            s.step(s.hold_action())
+
+    well = np.array([-0.100, 0.150, 0.027])
+    for ix, poly_list in enumerate(STROKES):
+        poly = np.asarray(poly_list, np.float64)
+        pts = resample(poly)
+        # Cross-sectional exemplar width from the distance to its boundary.
+        rad_px = map_coordinates(dist, [pts[:, 1], pts[:, 0]], order=1, mode="nearest")
+        # Smooth the raster stair-steps; crossings can inflate local radii, so
+        # cap at 10 mm while preserving the actual broad strokes.
+        radii = np.convolve(np.pad(rad_px, (3, 3), mode="edge"), np.ones(7) / 7, mode="valid")
+        desired_width = np.clip(2.0 * radii * PX, 0.65 / 1000, 10.0 / 1000)
+        # Wang width(z) = 1.187 z_cm - 0.03 cm. Convert desired footprint
+        # widths to paper press depths and taper the first/last few mm.
+        depth = np.clip((desired_width * 100.0 + 0.030) / 1.187, 0.20, 9.0) / 100.0
+        arc = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts, axis=0), axis=1))])
+        ramp = np.clip(arc / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+        endramp = np.clip((arc[-1] - arc) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+        taper = np.minimum(ramp, endramp)
+        depth = 0.00020 + (depth - 0.00020) * taper
+
+        # Lift, ink, and restore the brush between strokes to initialize its
+        # drag direction cleanly.
+        cur = s.tip_pose()[0]
+        go([cur[0], cur[1], 0.080], speed=0.05, settle=1)
+        go(well, speed=0.08, settle=3)
+        go([well[0], well[1], 0.080], speed=0.05, settle=1)
+
+        # Start a few pixels before the centreline so the tapered drag tail
+        # reaches the calligraphic stroke's entry point.
+        tangent = pts[1] - pts[0]
+        tangent /= max(1e-9, np.linalg.norm(tangent))
+        entry = pts[0] - tangent * 7.0
+        # image pixel -> the sheet's world coordinates
+        def world(uv, z):
+            x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(float(uv[0]), float(uv[1]))
+            return np.array([x, y, float(z)])
+
+        go(world(entry, 0.070), speed=0.08)
+        go(world(entry, 0.023), speed=0.025, settle=1)
+
+        # First direction sample is deliberately a near-zero touch so the
+        # reset brush learns the stroke tangent before it opens.
+        start = pts[0]
+        cmd(world(start, 0.01980))
+        for uv, press in zip(pts[1:], depth[1:]):
+            cmd(world(uv, 0.020 - float(press)))
+        go(world(pts[-1], 0.075), speed=0.025, settle=1)
+        print(f"stroke {ix + 1:02d}/{len(STROKES)}: {len(pts)} samples, press={depth.max()*1000:.1f} mm, steps={s.n_steps}", flush=True)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    s.painter.finish()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"source": "gen.py", "stroke_paths": STROKES, "ik_failures": bad_ik})
+    ink = s.ink() >= 0.5
+    target_mask = mask
+    inter = np.count_nonzero(ink & target_mask)
+    union = np.count_nonzero(ink | target_mask)
+    print({"actions": len(actions), "contacts": len(s.strokes()), "ik_failures": bad_ik,
+           "local_iou": inter / max(1, union), "precision": inter / max(1, np.count_nonzero(ink)),
+           "recall": inter / max(1, np.count_nonzero(target_mask)), "ink_px": int(ink.sum()), "target_px": int(target_mask.sum())}, flush=True)
+    cv2.imwrite("/app/output/candidate.png", s.canvas())
+    s.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
